text:
Me: I'll sleep early tonight.
Also me at 2am:
rewatching videos I've already seen.

Introverts don't hate people.
We just need 3-5 business days
to recover from one hangout.

Nothing feels better than plans
getting cancelled
by the other person.

My social battery doesn't drain.
It gets stolen
by specific people.

Psychology says if you can't sleep,
someone is thinking about you.
No. You have 47 unfinished thoughts.

I don't ghost people.
I just enter my hermit era
without an announcement.

Adulthood is saying
'after this week it'll calm down'
every week. Forever.

text:
My toxic trait?
Believing I can fix my sleep schedule
by ruining it one more time.

Overthinkers don't need enemies.
We lose arguments
that never happened.

text:
I'm not shy.
I'm just running a background check
on your energy.

Brain: remember that embarrassing moment?
Me: it's been 8 years.
Brain: anyway, here's the 4K remaster.

Some people are human sunshine.
Others are human
Monday mornings.

I don't have trust issues.
I have pattern recognition.

The audacity of my brain:
tired all day,
wide awake at midnight.

'Wanna call?'
No. Text me so I can respond
in 3-5 business hours.

I miss people in silence
and expect them
to feel it telepathically.

My love language is someone
remembering the small things
I said once.

Not lazy.
Just in energy-saving mode
since 2021.

The gym isn't my therapy.
Cancelling plans is.

I can forgive.
But my brain keeps receipts
with timestamps.

The person who worries about
being annoying
is never the annoying one.

text:
Me after saying 'you too'
when the waiter says enjoy your meal:
time to leave the country.

I'm at that age where my back hurts
from sleeping
and my soul hurts from emails.

Silence isn't empty.
It's full of answers
you're avoiding.

My phone is on silent.
Not because I'm busy.
Because I'm protecting my peace.

Everyone has that friend who
takes 6 hours to reply
but posts stories every 20 minutes.

I don't hold grudges.
I just remember facts
at strategic moments.

Maturity is watching someone
lie about you
and letting them finish.

My brain has 74 tabs open.
3 are frozen.
No idea where the music is coming from.

Introvert horror story:
'This call will now
require your camera.'

I overthink my overthinking.
That's the level
we're at now.

text:
Being an adult is googling
your symptoms
and then ignoring them professionally.

Real rest isn't sleep.
It's zero notifications
and nowhere to be.

text:
You're not behind in life.
You're comparing your chapter 3
to someone's chapter 20.

I love people who match my energy
instead of draining it.

My biggest red flag?
Saying 'I'm fine'
with the confidence of a liar.

We replay conversations
because we crave closure.
My brain calls it evening entertainment.

Some friendships die from a fight.
Most die from
'we should catch up soon.'

I'm not ignoring my problems.
I'm letting them marinate
while I nap.

Nothing ages you faster than asking
'how is it already July?'

My comfort zone has a couch,
snacks,
and zero small talk.

Emotional damage is
hearing your own voice
in a video.

The bravest thing I do daily
is check my bank account
without crying.

I fear starting a series
with 9 seasons.

Group chat psychology:
47 messages = memes.
1 message at 1am = someone needs to talk.

text:
My personality is 50% sarcasm,
30% anxiety,
and 20% snacks.

The glow up is real when you stop
explaining yourself to people
committed to misunderstanding you.

Sleep is my toxic ex.
Ignores me all night,
clings to me all morning.

Normalize leaving places
when your social battery
hits 1%.

My therapist: journaling helps.
My journal: 3 entries.
All from 2023.

Attention spans are so gone
we skip through videos
we chose to watch.

The older I get,
the more 'no'
feels like self-care.

Venting to the right person
is cheaper than therapy.
Choose your person wisely.

My red flags are organized
alphabetically.
At least I'm self-aware.

'Let's circle back' is corporate for
'this problem is now yours.'
